@Override
public void save(Owner owner) {          // lines 101-109

        this.em.persist(owner);
    } else {
        this.em.merge(owner);
    }

    if (this.registrationDate == null) {
        this.registrationDate = LocalDate.now();

The controller `addOwner` is **not** `@Transactional`, so there is no single surrounding transaction. Each `clinicService` call is its own transaction boundary (declared on `ClinicServiceImpl` via `org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional`), in this order:
